text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: More, more, more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I need to get stronger! I'm not good enough right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I need more strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the start of the Classic Triple Crown tour inches closer, even more reporters have begun visiting campus than usual.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm not even ready to stand on the starting line of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: While my legs are able to run, I must use them to push myself even further… to achieve the highest speeds I possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wow, the racers aiming for the Classics are incredible! Yaeno's already run about a million laps!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: For real… If I tried doing that training plan, I'd probably end up throwing up halfway through.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: This is not enough! I cannot content myself with this!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: They've both got plenty of drive, but…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I don't think Mejiro Ardan will make it in time, and I'm not sure about Yaeno Muteki, either. That recent loss has broken her winning streak.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: It's hard to say if she'll even be eligible to run in the Satsuki Sho. Hm… Wonder who'll be the pick for the win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "My pick to win, their pick to win."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No matter what anyone has to say about those two, I'm not going to stop what I'm doing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I bet the two of them will do whatever they can to enter the races in their best conditions, so I'll have to do the same.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since she reaffirmed her resolve to win the Derby, the fire in her eyes has grown brighter with every day the race draws closer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: One… two… All right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm ready! Let's start today's training session!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Pile on the exercises, and don't you dare go easy on me! Our normal regimen won't be enough!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try to meet her brightly burning enthusiasm and pay close attention to her exercises. She starts running, but then…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch her sprint down the track, it seems like her running form is completely thrown out of sorts for a split second.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It almost looks like she's injured somewhere…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Whew… How was that, Trainer?! I've still got plenty left in me!
choice_data_list: Are you trying to hide an injury?
Are you trying to hide an injury?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-no… What makes you say that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She avoids my gaze and draws back her right leg.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But… Um…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O's right calf is fully taped up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Multiple strips of tape crisscross her leg to help support the arch of her foot. I've seen this kind of taping method in a textbook before.
choice_data_list: This is the taping method for shin splints from Athletic Injuries 101.
This is the taping method for shin splints from Athletic Injuries 101.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A shin splint is a common injury among new athletes who increase their training volume too suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're especially prevalent in athletes whose muscles are still growing. Overworking their legs and running on hard surfaces causes their muscles and tendons to become inflamed.
choice_data_list: Have you been practicing in private?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gulp… Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But it only hurts for a moment when I kick off the ground! It's not even that bad, so I can bear with it!
choice_data_list: If it worsens, you won't be able to run at all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask her more about her injury, and it's thankfully not a serious one. Still, I should take her to the doctor's after this…
choice_data_list: Looks like you'll have to take a break from running.
Looks like you'll have to take a break from running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wha…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: W-wait a second! A break?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But you just saw how hard Yaeno was working and how determined Ardan was! I-I can't…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I can't just give up on such a big race. I don't care if it ruins my leg, I'm going to run in the—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: B-but…
choice_data_list: No one said anything about you giving up the race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer! Please come in! The room is over this way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I end up asking Sakura Chiyono O's parents for help, and we get permission to carry out her rehabilitation at her family home.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: I do apologize for how much trouble Chiyo's caused!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Honey! Honey! Chiyo and her trainer are here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh… That's enough, Mom! I'm gonna head in and start training already, OK?!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Oh, dear. She's still as shy and easily embarrassed as ever.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Trainer, thank you so much for helping Chiyo through this.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: I know her stubbornness is the reason you brought her here.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Once she sets her mind on something, she won't let it go until she accomplishes it, for better or worse.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: She'll even force herself to work through injuries—especially if there are people around who she doesn't want to lose to.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: It's why you took her away from school, yes? Here at home, she can concentrate on recovering, far removed from the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: I can't imagine the headaches she's caused you…
choice_data_list: Well, that determination of hers is also her strength.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Mom, stop talking Trainer's ears off! You're going to get in the way of my rehabilitation!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Goodness, this child! Fine, fine. Thank you again, Trainer. I hope you'll continue to support our daughter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: So what am I supposed to do again? Towel curls and calf raises?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm… Those are completely different from my usual exercises.
choice_data_list: They'll help with recovery and prevent future injuries.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Really?
choice_data_list: Of course we'll be seeing a doctor for treatment too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh… Yeah, that makes sense…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But the time I spend on this isn't just for my recovery—it's to prepare for my victory at the Satsuki Sho and the Derby too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, we focus our attention on Sakura Chiyono O's medical treatment and training to improve her strength.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shuffle! Shuffle!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh… The tatami mats are all torn up. Dad's gonna be so angry…

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Heehee! I don't think so. This is proof of how hard you're working, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: Chiyo, dear? Could you tell me about the other racers you'll be competing against?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uh, they're strong. They're talented, of course, and determined too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh! But I won't lose to them! No way!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O's Mother
text_block_list.text: I see. I was thinking about recording your races on the TV and passing them out to the folks in the neighborhood association.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wha?! That'd be so embarrassing! Just watch them yourself! That's good enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While being smothered in her mother's love, Sakura Chiyono O pours her soul into recovery and training.
